Capital Economics is one of the world’s leading independent economic research companies. We provide country and regional research on most of the major developed and emerging economies. We also provide overview services covering the global economy and financial markets, and have dedicated services providing research on commodities and on the property sector.
 Founded in 1999, we have gained an enviable reputation for original and insightful research and have built up a wide and distinguished client base. We produce publications for world-wide distribution and offer support to clients in their respective time-zones through our offices in London, Toronto and Singapore.
 Overall, more than 1,500 institutions subscribe to our publications. The majority are in the financial sector, including some of the world’s largest investment banks and wealth managers. We also have a growing number of corporate clients, as well as many relationships with governments and central banks, both in developed and emerging economies.
 The role 
 A macroeconomist working within our highly-regarded Latin America team, reporting to the Senior Emerging Markets economist. This person will possess strong analytical skills, be willing to challenge the consensus and have the ability to express themselves with clarity and concision. You will have an opportunity to contribute across the range of our work on Latin America and emerging markets more broadly 
 Contribute to our views and generate forecasts for key Latin American economies and their financial markets. Try to identify where consensus expectations are wrong.
 Produce frequent high-quality written economic analysis for our clients. This ranges from short notes published immediately after an event to longer, more detailed publications on issues that are likely to influence an economy over a number of years
 As your expertise grows, you would present these views directly to clients, whether in person, on the telephone or conference calls, or at seminars. You would also be encouraged to build your own profile, including through media appearances.
 A strong academic background with, at least, a good undergraduate degree in economics or a related discipline.
 At least two years’ experience analysing macroeconomic issues within the public sector, a financial institution or a research organisation. Previous experience covering Latin America would be an advantage but is not essential.
 The ability to communicate in an engaging and authoritative manner. You will be expected to contribute to internal debates and present the company's views to external parties, including clients and the media. The hiring process involves delivering a presentation. 
 Above all, strong writing skills. Most of our output is written, so the ability to structure a written argument in English and express it clearly and concisely is a must. The hiring process includes a writing assessment.
 At Capital Economics, we are striving to create a diverse workforce and inclusive environment, which we believe are critical to help us make better decisions for the company, our employees and our clients. A diverse and inclusive workplace makes for more innovative, engaged and empowered employees, from whom business strength can be derived. This is particularly important in macroeconomic research, which relies on a diversity of views and opinions to be relevant and insightful. 
 Capital Economics is committed to equality, inclusion and diversity. We encourage applications from all candidates regardless of ethnicity, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability or gender identity. If you need reasonable adjustments to be made to the application process to ensure you are not at a disadvantage to other candidates, please include this in your cover letter. This is applicable if you have a disability or if you are neurodiverse/hold neurodiverse traits. 
 We are an equal opportunities employer with an active DE&I programme. We recognize the importance of a diverse workforce and are dedicated to building a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered to bring their whole selves to work.  
 We strive to foster a workplace that values diversity and promotes mutual respect and understanding. Our hiring practices are based on business needs, merit and qualifications. Capital Economics ensures that all employment decisions are made without bias, and we continuously work to eliminate discrimination and harassment in all forms.

ROLE: SENIOR MEDIA DIRECTOR ( Financial Institution Experience) 
 TEAM: MEDIA 
 LOCATION: TORONTO (HYBRID 2X/WEEK) 
 COMPANY OVERVIEW 
 At Salt Media , we're on a mission to earn the world's attention. As the media division of Salt XC, we're building a different kind of agency where media, commerce, creative, data and technology work as a single connected team. Our people combine strategic thinking with AI-powered tools, automation and advanced analytics to help some of North America's most recognized brands solve complex business challenges and drive measurable growth. We move quickly, challenge convention, and believe the best ideas come from curious people who are empowered to experiment. If you're looking to do career-defining work alongside smart, ambitious teammates in an environment that's shaping the future of media, we'd love to meet you. 
 ROLE OVERVIEW 
 As a Senior Media Director, you’ll set the strategic direction for how media investment is planned, bought, and optimized across CPG clients in North America. Operating at the intersection of media strategy and team leadership, you’ll ensure every plan is grounded in strong channel logic, sound investment principles, and a clear line to business outcomes.
 You’ll own cross-channel strategy and plan alignment across your portfolio, setting the optimization roadmap and reporting rhythm that keeps campaigns performing against KPIs. You’ll lead a team of media managers and directors — training them on tools and platforms, mentoring their growth, and ensuring the team’s segmentation and audience strategies stay sharp as channels evolve.
 You bring a senior media point of view that Account leads and clients rely on, and a team looks up to. You move fluidly between investment strategy and hands-on problem-solving, and you know how to translate performance data into a clear learning agenda for the whole team.
 CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Media Planning & Buying 
 Lead plan development and investment approach across your portfolio, ensuring every plan is grounded in strong strategic rationale.
 Set standards for I/O accuracy, spec compliance, and buy execution across the team.
 Own the relationship and day-to-day investment approach with key media platforms and partners, escalating and resolving issues as they arise.
 Partner with Account leadership to align media investment with broader account strategy and business objectives.
 Integrated Media Strategy 
 Own cross-channel strategy and plan alignment for your portfolio, ensuring full-funnel thinking connects to brand and business objectives.
 Translate client briefs into integrated, cross-channel investment approaches that scale across accounts.
 Guide Account and Creative partners on how channel strategy supports the broader campaign narrative.
 Measurement, Analytics & Reporting 
 Lead post-campaign reporting and the learning agenda across your portfolio, ensuring insights translate into sharper future plans.
 Build stakeholder trust in the measurement approach, aligning on what success looks like (e.g., brand-building vs. performance KPIs) before campaigns launch.
 Guide the team on complex channel plans and measurement matrices, including test-and-learn frameworks.
 Media Tools & Platform Fluency 
 Train and support the team on platform and tool use, ensuring consistent, fluent execution across the portfolio.
 Maintain platform reliability and troubleshoot tool-related issues that affect delivery.
 Stay current on new platform capabilities and flag opportunities to apply them across accounts.
 Performance Optimization & Testing 
 Set the optimization roadmap for your portfolio and drive its implementation across the team.
 Ensure consistent delivery against KPIs, stepping in to course-correct underperforming campaigns.
 Champion a test-and-learn mindset, ensuring findings are documented and applied across future plans.
 Channel & Audience Expertise 
 Build segmentation strategies and platform-specific audience logic that sharpen targeting across your portfolio.
 Guide the team on applying audience insights and platform data to refine channel-specific approaches.
 Stay ahead of shifts in channel and audience behavior, bringing new thinking to the team and to clients.
 Leadership, Management & Administration 
 Manage and develop direct reports across the media team; own performance conversations, goal-setting, and career development planning.
 Build team capability and bench strength through deliberate coaching, structured feedback, and stretch assignments.
 Model the leadership behaviors and professional standards that define Salt Media’s team culture.
 Contribute to team-wide planning processes, hiring decisions, and operational improvements in partnership with departmental leadership.
 Champion a culture of accountability, clarity, and continuous improvement within your media team.
 EXPERIENCE & SKILLS 
 8–12 years of experience in media planning, buying, or investment strategy, including 5+ years in a senior media leadership role within a media or integrated agency.
 Financial Institution Experience 
 Proven track record leading cross-channel media strategy and investment across a portfolio of clients or campaigns.
 Demonstrated people management experience, including direct report oversight, performance management, and career development.
 Deep fluency across media platforms, tools, and measurement systems, with the ability to train and elevate a team’s capability.
 Strong analytical acumen, with experience translating performance data into a clear learning agenda and optimization roadmap.
 Excellent communicator and confident senior presenter; able to align Account, Creative, and client stakeholders around a media point of view.
 Strategically minded, with the ability to connect media investment to measurable business outcomes.
 Highly organized, decisive, and calm under pressure; able to lead a team through ambiguity while maintaining clarity of direction.
 PERKS & BENEFITS THAT SET US APART 
 We don’t just talk about balance, growth, and culture, we build for it: 
 Work-Life Flexibility: Hybrid setup, up to 28 paid days off and winter holiday shutdowns.
 Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, and vision plans, plus Salt Bucks to spend on what matters to you - wellness, RRSPs, or extra time off.
 Growth-Driven Culture: Dedicated Salt Days, learning access, and formal leadership development. 
 Celebration-First Mentality: Legendary team trips, seasonal socials, and Salt Swag that reps your squad.
 Real Rewards: Referral and new business bonuses, phone reimbursement to support your everyday work, exclusive lifestyle perks, and personalized wellness options.
 Culture of Belonging: DEI programs, active ERGs, and a workplace where every voice counts.
 WHAT WE STAND FOR 
 Salt of the Earth: We lead with humility, honesty, and heart — always. 
 Do What’s Right: No shortcuts. We choose integrity over ease, every time. 
 Earn Your Salt: We roll up our sleeves, chase results, and celebrate the journey. 
 Make Things Better: We’re solution-seekers, always pushing for smarter ways forward. 
 Seek Different Perspectives: Diversity fuels our thinking. Inclusion drives our impact. 
 The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $140,000–$150,000. Individual compensation within this range is determined based on job-related factors such as experience, skills, level of responsibility, internal equity, and business needs. This range represents the expected base salary for this role and does not include other elements of SALT’s total rewards program.

PressReader  is an innovative technology company that partners with the world’s leading publishers to deliver content to millions of users in over 160 countries. Our progressive approach to digital distribution has allowed publishers such as The Washington Post, The Guardian, Newsweek, Rolling Stone, The Globe and Mail, and Vogue to find new audiences through business partnerships, including airlines, hotels, cruise ships, libraries, and thousands of other companies worldwide. 
 Our technology also powers Editions Plus - a white-label solution that enables publishers to deliver their digital content in interactive ways. Editions+ allows them to build a customizable platform that supports a wide range of revenue opportunities. 
 We have a full-time, permanent opportunity for a Tax Manager to join our Accounting team. 
 As a Tax Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely tax filings, supporting financial reporting requirements, managing transfer pricing documentation, and advising the business on tax matters related to growth, operations, and cross-border activity. 
 This is a role for a detail-oriented and proactive tax professional to oversee tax compliance, reporting, planning, and process improvement across multiple jurisdictions. 
 In this role, you will: 
Tax Compliance and Reporting 
 Prepare, review, and file indirect tax returns accurately and on time across applicable jurisdictions.
 Ensure VAT, GST/HST, sales tax, and other indirect tax requirements are properly reflected in invoicing and reporting processes.
 Prepare tax-related journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules for the profit and loss statement and balance sheet.
 Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities to ensure compliance with IFRS and corporate policies.
 Estimate current and deferred tax exposures for budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting purposes.
 Maintain complete and accurate documentation to support tax filings, reconciliations, and audit requirements.
 Tax Planning and Strategy 
 Identify and implement tax planning opportunities to optimize the company's tax position while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
 Provide practical tax guidance on new business initiatives, cross-border transactions, restructuring, and other strategic projects.
 Monitor changes in tax legislation and indirect tax requirements across relevant jurisdictions and assess their impact on the business.
 Research and support applications for applicable tax credits, incentives, and government subsidy programs.
 Identify tax risks and opportunities and recommend appropriate actions to management.
 Conduct ad hoc tax research and provide clear recommendations on evolving rules, regulations, and business requirements.
 Transfer Pricing 
 Maintain and update intercompany transfer pricing policies and documentation in line with OECD guidelines and local requirements.
 Monitor intercompany transactions to ensure they comply with established transfer pricing policies.
 Prepare and maintain transfer pricing documentation for all intercompany transactions.
 Ensure intercompany agreements align with transfer pricing policies and applicable requirements.
 Collaboration and Communication 
 Communicate with tax authorities across multiple jurisdictions and monitor the organization's tax position.
 Work closely with external tax advisors to support corporate tax filings and ensure ongoing tax compliance.
 Partner with Accounting, Legal, Sales, and other stakeholders to provide timely and accurate tax support.
 Communicate effectively with external auditors and internal stakeholders on direct tax, indirect tax, withholding tax, and transfer pricing matters.
 Translate complex tax matters into clear, practical guidance for business partners.
 Process Improvement and Controls 
 Evaluate and improve tax processes, controls, and documentation to enhance compliance, accuracy, and efficiency.
 Streamline and automate the extraction of information required for tax analysis, reporting, and reconciliations.
 Implement and leverage tax technology solutions where appropriate to improve reporting quality and reduce manual effort.
   You are a great fit if you have: 
 5+ years of progressive tax experience, preferably in a multinational or multi-jurisdictional environment. 
 Strong knowledge of corporate tax, indirect tax, withholding tax, and transfer pricing principles. 
 Experience working with tax compliance and reporting across multiple jurisdictions. 
 Familiarity with IFRS and financial reporting processes. 
 Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail. 
 Ability to communicate clearly with internal stakeholders, external advisors, auditors, and tax authorities. 
 Bonus points if you have: 
 Experience with process improvement, automation, or tax technology solutions. 
 Experience working at an international accounting firm.
 Professional accounting designation (e.g. CPA, Master of Taxation) or equivalent tax experience
 Ability to own the company’s tax function and provide strategic tax recommendations and guidance to support business objectives

 Front-End Foundations is the enablement team behind our internal React component library that implements Manulife's design system. It powers 100+ active digital properties across our Canadian and US segments, is endorsed at the enterprise architecture level as our standard for React development and has an active engineering community of over 1,000 people. We solve common front-end problems once, then make those solutions available to every product team.
 We are seeking a self-motivated Front-End Engineer to help build the components, tooling, documentation, and AI capabilities that thousands of Manulife engineers depend on daily. This is a product engineering role: the library is the product, and developers are the customers.
 Position Responsibilities:  
 Build the libraries: Design, build, and maintain accessible, well-tested React components, design tokens, and tooling that align to and support the enterprise design system.
 Own accessibility: Strive to achieve WCAG 2.2 AA level. Implement ARIA authoring practices, keyboard interaction, and assistive technology support so that every consuming team inherits compliance by default.
 Design APIs that last: Shape component APIs used by hundreds of applications. Think in terms of backwards compatibility, semantic versioning, deprecation paths, and migration guidance — not just the next release.
 Enable adoption: Extend our Next.js documentation platform, live code sandbox, examples, and Figma Code Connect integration so teams can learn, adopt, and stay current with minimal friction.
 Advance AI-native tooling: Contribute to our MCP server, Copilot agent skills, LLM-friendly documentation endpoints, and generative UI guardrails so AI agents produce accessible, on-brand interfaces that stay inside our design system rather than around it.
 Think beyond React: Help evolve a shared headless component core so component logic is built once and shipped across web, mobile, and future platforms.
 Support the community: Triage issues, review external contributions, and unblock delivery teams. Our support channel is one of the largest active engineering communities in the company.
 Collaborate with designers, architects, and product teams: Partner across disciplines in an agile delivery model to identify pain points and accelerate delivery of new business value.
 Required Qualifications: 
 5 or more years  building production front-end applications or shared libraries, ideally in complex enterprise environments
 Deep hands-on expertise in  React and TypeScript , plus modern CSS
 Practical  accessibility  experience: semantic HTML, ARIA, focus and keyboard management, and testing with assistive technology
 Experience building  reusable libraries, design systems, or shared platforms consumed by other engineers , with genuine empathy for developer experience
 Testing discipline across unit, integration, visual regression, and automated accessibility checks
 Familiarity with monorepos, CI/CD, release automation, and semantic versioning
 movement to change the engineering culture of an enterprise
 Strong verbal and written communication, with the ability to articulate technical vision, trade-offs, and outcomes to both engineers and leadership
 Familiarity with agile and DevOps principles, test-driven development, continuous integration, and other software engineering best practices
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 A capacity for constant learning from both success and failure, remaining open to change and continuous improvement
 An entrepreneurial spirit and comfort working within a rapidly changing environment; you love the challenge of working on a small team and being part of a larger
 Curiosity about AI-assisted development and how agents consume design systems and structured component knowledge

Pretty Isn’t Good Enough: Your portfolio proves you know how to take a marketing idea and turn it into design that grabs attention, communicates the message fast, and gets people to act. You know how to lead and mentor a team of designers, raise the visual bar, and keep projects moving without sacrificing quality.
 Most importantly, you understand this:
 Great design isn’t just decoration. It’s salesmanship in pixels.  
 If that sounds like you, and you’re excited by the idea of raising the creative standard across a fast-growing health and wellness brand, you might just be the Lead Graphic Designer AlgaeCal is looking for.
 This job will give you ALL the feels:
 At AlgaeCal, we’re driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density. 
 The good news? AlgaeCal has the world’s only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.
 Here’s what you’ll be up to in this busy role:
 Helping talented designers become even better. You’ll set the standard, give clear feedback, and make sure the work keeps improving.
 Making sure every piece of creative is on-brand, easy to understand, and built to get a result. Because at AlgaeCal, “looks nice” is never the finish line.
 Taking the lead on major campaigns, product launches, website projects, and other big creative initiatives from the first idea right through to the finished work.
 Reviewing creative before it goes out the door and making sure the feedback process is clear, useful, and fast. No vague comments. No endless revision loops.
 Setting clear goals for the design team so everyone knows what great looks like, what matters most, and where their time should be going.
 Meeting regularly with your designers to coach them, support them, challenge them, and help them grow.
 Working closely with our Project Management Team to keep priorities straight, workloads realistic, and deadlines on track without letting quality slip.
 Looking at how our creative actually performs and asking the important questions. Did it get attention? Did people understand it? Did it work?
 Keeping up with new design trends, tools, and AI technology, then using the good stuff and ignoring the gimmicks.
 This job might be for you if you’ve got…
 5+ years of professional graphic design experience and a portfolio that makes us say “holy smokes we HAVE to talk!”
 Proven experience mentoring designers. You know how to give useful feedback, raise the bar, and get great work out of people without becoming the creative tyrant no one wants to work with.
 Serious Adobe Creative Suite skills, especially Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and After Effects. Premiere Pro is a nice bonus. You’ll also need to know Figma inside out and back to front. 
 A strong background in digital marketing and e-commerce. You’re not just a designer. You understand that your work has to help sell. Sales pages, emails, paid ads, landing pages, funnels... none of this should be foreign territory. If you need to Google “CTR,” this probably isn’t the job for you.
 The ability to design across pretty much everything we throw at you, including ads, websites, email, social, print, packaging, presentations, and other marketing collateral.
 Experience using AI creative tools to work faster, explore ideas, and improve output without making everything look like it was made by AI.
 E-commerce, Amazon, or marketplace experience gets you bonus points.
 Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If you’re nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we can’t wait to meet you.
 Qualities That Make You An Ideal Teammate  
 At AlgaeCal we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:
 You’re humble, you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own
 You’re hungry to learn more
 You’re people smart, in the sense that you’re a great teammate
 The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities you won’t last long at AlgaeCal. So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.
 What Will You Earn? 
Let’s discuss your salary during the interview process, but know that we’re a generous team and we know how to reward top talent!
 You’ll also enjoy the following benefits:
 A generous healthcare package
 Monthly team events and activities
 Flexible Stat Holidays with the option to bank days for later use
 Weekly team lunches
 Casual dress code
 Incredible dog friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
 Professional Development: You’ll get the opportunity to attend professional development conferences or workshops that will enhance your skills, expand your network, and drive your career forward with our support! And of course, we’ll cover your fees, accommodation, travel, meals, and any related materials or resources.
 And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.
 How To Apply 
 So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?
 Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Lead Graphic Designer is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:
 If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully: 
 1. Write a cover letter addressing: 
 Why are you the best Lead Graphic Designer for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements and experience.
 Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here : http://shorturl.at/lptFT 
 What's the toughest challenge you’ve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?
 What are the last three books you’ve read?
 What do you do for fun?
 2. Explain what you’re doing now for a job: 
  If you don’t have one, explain why.
  If you have one, explain why you’re looking elsewhere.
 3. Upload your cover letter, resume, and link to your portfolio 
 Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.
 Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.
 Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume. 
 ***Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read! Include the URL to your portfolio*** 
 We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly and you can also expect a prompt response.

À PROPOS DE POWER FACTORS 
 Power Factors est un chef de file mondial dans le développement de logiciels de gestion du rendement des énergies renouvelables. Notre plateforme Unity permet aux propriétaires et exploitants d'actifs de maximiser la production d'énergie, de réduire les coûts d'exploitation et de contribuer à la transition énergétique mondiale. Nous collaborons avec des clients partout dans le monde pour accélérer le déploiement d'une énergie propre et fiable. 
 À PROPOS DU POSTE 
 Nous sommes à la recherche d'un·e consultant·e principal·e en conception pédagogique pour concevoir et développer une gamme complète de contenus de formation en leadership et en compétences interpersonnelles. Il s'agit d'un mandat à temps partiel et à durée déterminée qui allie une réflexion stratégique sur la conception des apprentissages à un développement concret de contenus. La personne idéale agit à titre de consultant·e hybride, à l'aise aussi bien dans un rôle-conseil stratégique que dans le développement des livrables finaux. 
 Type de mandat : consultant·e indépendant·e / contrat, temps partiel (~20 heures/semaine) 
 Durée : mandat de 4 à 6 mois 
 Lieu de travail : télétravail; candidat·e·s basé·e·s à Montréal préféré·e·s 
 Date de début : immédiatement 
 Relève de : vice-présidence aux ressources humaines 
 La facilitation de sessions en direct n'est pas une exigence de ce mandat, mais les candidat·e·s à l'aise et disponibles pour animer des sessions pourront se voir confier cette responsabilité. 
 RESPONSABILITÉS 
 Réaliser des analyses de besoins et traduire les compétences en leadership et les habiletés interpersonnelles en objectifs d'apprentissage clairs et mesurables 
 Concevoir des solutions d'apprentissage selon une approche de microapprentissage structuré qui décompose les sujets complexes en unités modulaires et séquencées, s'appuyant les unes sur les autres 
 Développer des contenus de formation en ligne compatibles avec notre système de gestion de l'apprentissage (LMS) TalentLMS, sous forme de packages SCORM 1.2 ou xAPI (Experience API); l'outil de création est flexible, pourvu que l'exportation finale respecte cette exigence 
 Produire des vidéos et d'autres ressources numériques en format court 
 Concevoir des présentations pour des formations en présentiel et en virtuel, ainsi que des guides d'animation 
 Animer des sessions en direct, selon la disponibilité et les aptitudes de la personne consultante 
 Appliquer les meilleures pratiques en conception pédagogique tout au long du cycle complet : analyse, conception, développement et évaluation (p. ex., ADDIE, SAM ou un modèle équivalent) 
 Intégrer des évaluations formatives et sommatives, et concevoir des approches d'évaluation qui vont au-delà des mesures de réaction et de complétion pour viser l'application des comportements 
 S'assurer que les contenus sont accessibles et inclusifs (p. ex., sous-titrage, structure lisible, textes alternatifs) et conformes aux principes d'apprentissage des adultes 
 Respecter les directives de marque et de style graphique existantes pour l'ensemble des présentations, vidéos et contenus de formation en ligne 
 Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes et les expert·e·s en la matière pour valider l'exactitude et la pertinence des contenus 
 Participer aux cycles de révision et d'approbation avec l'équipe de direction des ressources humaines (trois membres) 
 Gérer son propre échéancier de travail et ses livrables selon le calendrier du mandat, avec des points de suivi réguliers 
 Livrer une suite de modules de microapprentissage conformes à SCORM 1.2 ou xAPI, testés et fonctionnels dans TalentLMS 
 Constituer une bibliothèque de vidéos de microapprentissage en leadership 
 Produire des présentations de formation et des plans de session prêts à l'animation 
 Développer des outils d'évaluation et de mesure complémentaires 
 PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Vous êtes à l'aise aussi bien dans un rôle-conseil stratégique que dans le développement concret de contenus pédagogiques.  EXIGENCES 
 7 ans ou plus d'expérience en conception pédagogique, avec un portfolio solide en développement du leadership et/ou en formation aux compétences interpersonnelles 
 Expérience démontrée dans la conception de microapprentissages et l'utilisation de techniques de structuration progressive pour développer les compétences 
 Expérience pratique dans la création de packages conformes à SCORM 1.2 ou xAPI et dans l'utilisation d'un LMS (expérience avec TalentLMS : un atout)

 Capacité à concevoir des supports de formation en présentiel et des guides d'animation de qualité professionnelle 
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et en développement de contenus 
 Aisance à travailler dans le cadre d'une charte graphique et d'un guide de style établis 
 Solides compétences en gestion de projet et capacité à travailler de façon autonome dans un contexte de consultation à temps partiel en télétravail 
 Bilinguisme français canadien et anglais : un atout important

En tant que consultant·e principal·e, vous mettrez votre expertise au service de défis organisationnels concrets — en concevant des apprentissages qui vont au-delà des formations obligatoires pour viser un véritable changement de comportement.  _____________________ 
 ABOUT POWER FACTORS 
 Power Factors is a global leader in renewable energy performance management software. Our Unity platform enables asset owners and operators to maximize energy production, reduce operational costs, and support the global energy transition. We partner with clients worldwide to accelerate the deployment of clean, reliable energy. 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for a Senior Instructional Design Consultant to design and build a suite of leadership development and soft skills training content. This is a part-time, fixed-term consulting mandate that combines strategic learning design with hands-on content development. The ideal candidate operates as a hybrid between a learning and development consultant and a production-focused instructional designer, comfortable advising on approach as well as building the final deliverables. 
 Engagement type: independent consultant / contract, part-time (~20 hours/week) 
 Duration: 4–6 month mandate 
 Location: remote; Montreal-based candidates preferred 
 Start date: immediate 
 Reports to: VP of Human Resources

 WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING 
 Conduct needs assessments and translate leadership competencies and soft skills into clear, measurable learning objectives

 Design live and virtual training decks and facilitator session materials

 Adhere to existing brand and style guidelines across all decks, videos, and eLearning content 
 Collaborate with internal stakeholders and subject-matter experts to validate content accuracy and relevance 
 Participate in review and approval cycles with the HR leadership team (three members) 
 Manage own workback schedule and deliverables against the mandate timeline, with regular check-ins 
 Deliver a suite of SCORM 1.2 or xAPI-compliant microlearning modules, tested and functional in TalentLMS 
 Build a library of leadership microlearning videos 
 Produce facilitator-ready live training decks and session plans 
 Develop supporting assessment and evaluation materials 
 WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL 
 7+ years of experience in instructional design, with a strong portfolio in leadership development and/or soft skills training 
 Demonstrated experience designing microlearning and using scaffolding techniques to build skill progression 
 Hands-on experience building SCORM 1.2 or xAPI-compliant packages and working within an LMS (TalentLMS experience an asset) 
 Ability to export and render content in SCORM 1.2 or xAPI format regardless of the authoring tool used 
 Strong grounding in adult learning theory and instructional design models (ADDIE, SAM, Bloom's taxonomy, etc.) 
 Ability to design polished live-training and facilitator materials 
 Excellent written communication and content development skills 
 Comfortable working within an established brand and style guide 
 Strong project management skills and the ability to work autonomously in a part-time, remote consulting capacity 
 Bilingual in English and Canadian French: a strong asset 
 WOULD BE AN ASSET

 Experience with competency mapping and competency-based content architecture 
 Familiarity with accessibility and UDL standards in eLearning 
 Prior consulting experience with corporate clients on leadership or people-manager programs 
 Proficiency in additional languages (e.g., Greek): an asset 
 WHY THIS ROLE

You will work with a lean, engaged HR leadership team that values your strategic input, while enjoying the autonomy and flexibility of a remote, part-time consulting model. At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Staff Backend Software Engineer at Harvey, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the foundation of our product platform while directly building user-facing features for some of the world’s leading law firms and enterprise customers. This team owns and operates the platform layer that enables secure, reliable, and flexible experiences for our customers including notifications, permissions and feature flag infrastructure. We also build enterprise-grade collaboration experiences for law firms.

You will design and own systems that not only serve as critical infrastructure for the rest of the company, but also directly impact how our users engage with Harvey’s AI-powered legal tools. This role is ideal for engineers who are excited by the opportunity to move between deep platform thinking and hands-on product iteration.

This role is based in Toronto, Canada. We use an in-person work model and offer relocation assistance to new employees.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and build foundational backend infrastructure including authentication, permissions, feature flagging, notifications, and document management integrations

 - Build and evolve Harvey’s internal product platform, accelerating development across multiple product lines and engineering teams

 - Lead development of enterprise-facing features, such as secure multi-party collaboration, cross-organization workflows, and robust admin controls

 - Maintain high standards for security, privacy, and system reliability, particularly in handling sensitive legal data

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with product, AI, design, and GTM teams to deliver delightful, enterprise-ready experiences
   
   


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 10+ years (post-BS/MS) of backend-focused software engineering experience on platform and/or product-oriented teams

 - Experience working across the stack to ship user-facing features with measurable impact

 - Strong knowledge of distributed systems, REST/gRPC APIs, databases, and scalable service architectures

 - Familiarity with or interest in enterprise SaaS patterns, such as role-based access control (RBAC), feature flag systems, and third-party integrations

 - Track record of shipping highly intuitive products, strong attention to detail

 - Experience building backend platforms that can support multiple product lines

 - Strong programming skills and general Computer Science knowledge




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Be part of building something special as a founding member of our Toronto team

 - Structured hybrid working arrangement: 3 days in our Toronto office, 2 days working from home
   
   


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 

 - Location: Toronto, Ontario (Hybrid with flexibility)

 - Work eligibility: Must have valid Canadian work rights; Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role
   
   


COMPENSATION

CAD $196,800 - $270,600

Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies — niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore.

Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently — accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable.

We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better.

Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a highly ambitious paralegal to join Beacon’s legal team and serve as the day-to-day point of contact for post-close legal integration across Beacon’s acquisitions, from LOI signing through full integration completion. Reporting to Beacon’s Senior Paralegal and Legal Operations Lead, you will be the hands-on paralegal executing the legal integration workstream on every deal - owning corporate governance clean-up, driving diligence follow-up, and building out integration workflows for legal, while ensuring every integration gets across the finish line. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for a paralegal who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to be at the center of Beacon’s integration strategy. You will execute the legal integration workstream internally as the primary legal resource on each transaction post-close,working directly with our M&A, legal and Integration teams, coordinating with our registered agent providers, and handling post-closing matters across our growing portfolios. We are looking for someone who is ready to do the heavy lifting on integration – someone with broad legal judgment who can spot and address general legal and compliance issues beyond the four corners of the post-closing checklist, and who is prepared to leverage AI tools to drive efficiency across the entire integration lifecycle.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Integration Project Management: Lead the legal integration workstream for newly acquired companies - collaborating cross-functionally to ensure alignment with company policy and compliance requirements, and maintaining integration dashboards, project plans, and status documentation.

• Legal Operations & Workflow: Build out Beacon's legal integration workflows and program, manage the library of approved templates and resources, and lead each newly acquired company's introduction to Beacon Legal.

• Diligence Support: Review data rooms and assist Legal in collecting, reviewing, and summarizing diligence information with an eye toward post-close integration, and help scope clean-up items.

• Corporate Management & Compliance: Transfer registered agent services, complete state and DBA registrations, and clean up minute books.

• Tracking & Reporting: Own the post-close tracker from day one through completion - maintaining accurate records of the transaction, legal integration milestones, and flagging items that require timeline extensions.

• Risk Management: Assist with identifying, escalating, and mitigating legal risk in existing agreements (customer, vendor, partner, contractor) or practices, alongside internal and external counsel.

• Record Management: Ensure employment agreements, customer contracts, and other key agreements and corporate records are saved in a centralized repository.




WHO YOU ARE:

• Licensed paralegal in good standing with the Law Society of Ontario.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

• 1–3 years of experience as a corporate clerk, paralegal, or in a corporate governance/legal support role, ideally within a multi-entity environment (M&A integration, private equity, venture capital, or holding company experience preferred).

• Strong knowledge of corporate governance practices, minute book management, and entity lifecycle administration, including a strong working understanding of Canadian and U.S. corporate entity law (federal and provincial/state) and how it applies to multi-entity structures.

• Familiarity with U.S. state and Canadian provincial corporate filing requirements, including annual reports, foreign qualifications, and DBA registrations.

• Experience managing cross-jurisdictional compliance obligations and coordinating with registered agents and external counsel.

• Strong organizational and project management skills, with high attention to detail.

• Highly Proficient with AI tools for legal work (e.g., AI-assisted contract review, document drafting, legal research). A genuine enthusiasm and need for integrating AI into day-to-day legal practice is essential.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office / Google Suite and project management tools (Asana, Zendesk or similar)

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-volume deal environment with multiple concurrent transactions and shifting priorities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal concepts into clear, actionable guidance for non-legal business partners.

• Self-directed operator who can own the corporate governance function end-to-end with minimal supervision – setting priorities, driving deadlines, managing advisors, and leading cross-functional projects independently. Comfortable making judgment calls, escalating only what truly needs escalation, and running this workstream as the internal expert.

• Experience with vertical market software, SaaS, or technology-focused M&A transactions is a strong plus.


Our Values at Beacon Software

 - Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time.

 - Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant.

 - Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected.

 - Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world - compounding growth.


How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.

 

AI does not make hiring decisions: Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

 Rising Edge Group is an electrical contracting company founded in 2002, specialization in high-voltage electrical solutions that power critical infrastructure across North America. With operations in both Canada and the United States, we partner with clients across the electrical utilities, renewable energy, and industrial sectors to design, build, and maintain the critical infrastructure systems communities and industries rely on.

 What You'll Do   
 Reporting to the Site Supervisor, the role of Journeyperson Electrician is to perform maintenance, upgrading and installation of equipment in 13.8kV to 500 kV substations. Under this role the Journeyperson Electrician reads and interprets drawings, blueprints and electrical code specifications. The Journeyperson Electrician is also responsible for planning layout and illustration of electrical wiring, equipment and fixtures based on specifications. The Journeyperson Electrician inspects electrical systems, components and equipment to identify defects and to ensure compliance with codes. This is a senior role which requires performance evaluation, coaching mentoring and training of Electrical Apprentices. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 The responsibilities include, but may not be limited to: 
 Installation, troubleshooting, repairs, and maintenance of different electrical systems, faulty equipment and apparatus including transformers, circuit breakers, switches, switchgears, instrument transformers, relays and other related equipment (500kV, 240kV, 144kV, 69kV, 25kV, 13.8kV).

 Operation of construction equipment such as skid steer, mini hoe, manlifts, and zoom booms.
 Comply with Rising Edge Technologies Ltd.’s Health and Safety Manual and industry safety regulations.

 Responsible for Inspection and testing of high voltage electrical equipment installed in a substation. Ensure test and maintenance reports are maintained and completed at all times
 Lead installation and facilitate planning of ground grids, assembly of power system equipment, cabling and wiring
 Ensure all electrical work complies with Technical Safety BC requirements, applicable permits and inspections, and company standards
 Adhere to Rising Edge Technologies Ltd.’s safety policies and safe work procedures and be familiar with the potential hazards of working near energized equipment.
 Additional Information     
 This position supports projects throughout British Columbia and will require travel within the province.
 This position is designated as safety-sensitive making employment contingent upon the successful completion of pre-employment drug and alcohol testing, as well as criminal and general background checks.

Maple’s purpose is to meet the world's healthcare needs. We’re Canada's leading on-demand healthcare platform, connecting patients with Canadian-licensed doctors, nurse practitioners and specialists. Today, we’re proud that over 8 million patients and 7,000 businesses and government partners have access to same-day, proactive and ongoing care. We enable people to take control of their health and push the boundaries of what’s possible every day.  
Bold minds. Big impact. A career at Maple is about making an impact. We empower bold thinking, surround you with an inspiring team and are driven by a motivating purpose. Here, you’ll do work that changes lives—including your own.

The role: As we continue to scale the delivery of care to Maple members, we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Maple’s provider experience—the product engine, supply-side tools, and workflows used by our doctors, nurse practitioners, and specialists—as well as the software supporting our Clinical and Customer Support Operations teams.
 In this role, you’ll own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for this portfolio and lead it from discovery through launch and iteration. You’ll get close to complex user and operational workflows, use data, research, and AI to make ideas tangible faster, and partner with your squad, clinicians, and operations leaders to turn high-friction problems into simple, scalable product experiences—including spotting where AI can create meaningful value across our platform.
Your responsibilities: As the Senior Product Manager, you will:
 Own the product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for provider experience and clinical operations, with a focus on better care delivery and more effective, scalable operations.
 Develop a deep understanding of providers and internal operational teams through research, data, workflow observation, and close partnership.
 Lead initiatives from discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration, using data, feedback, and business context to make sure the squad is solving the right problems and delivering real value.
 Bring a builder mentality to the work: get close to the details, use AI and other tools to make ideas tangible, and help the squad move quickly from a problem to a testable solution.
 Translate complex clinical, operational, technical, and regulatory needs into clear product direction and scalable workflows.
 Partner closely with engineering and design to shape solutions, make thoughtful trade-offs, and deliver simple, high-quality experiences.
 Identify and validate where AI can meaningfully improve provider or clinical workflows, balancing user value, safety, feasibility, and business impact.
 Create alignment across Clinical, Clinical, Customer Support, Product, Engineering, Data, and other partners, surfacing risks, dependencies, and changes early.
What success looks like: In your first 90 days, you’ll build a strong understanding of Maple’s provider experience, clinical operations, current roadmap, technology, and key metrics. You’ll build trusted relationships with your squad, providers, clinical operation leaders, and other key stakeholders, take ownership of in-flight work, clarify the biggest opportunities and risks, and align the group on the following quarter’s priorities.
 Over the next 12 to 18 months, you’ll deliver measurable improvements to the provider experience and the effectiveness of clinical operations. You’ll set a clear product strategy and roadmap, lead several complex initiatives through launch and iteration, help the squad move faster from problem to working version, and deliver AI-enabled solutions that create real value. Success will show up in the portfolio’s most important outcomes, strong execution, and trusted cross-functional relationships.
What you bring: 5+ years of product management experience in a software environment.
 Experience leading a cross-functional product squad and taking products or meaningful features from discovery through launch and iteration.
 Strong strategic thinking, prioritization, problem-solving, and product judgment, paired with the ability to execute.
 The ability to use data, research, and customer insight to define outcomes and make product decisions.
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to create alignment across different teams.
 Comfort working through ambiguity, complex workflows, and competing priorities.
 A builder mentality and a keen interest in AI. You’re comfortable moving from strategy to hands-on problem-solving, experimenting with AI directly, and using good judgment about where it can create value.
 A collaborative, resilient, and low-ego approach, with the ability to influence without relying on authority.
 Bonus points for experience in healthcare or another regulated industry, provider or operational products, complex platforms or integrations, or building and launching AI-enabled products.

LOCUM PEDIATRIC ONCOLOGIST, SOLID TUMOR ONCOLOGY 
 DIVISION OF HEMATOLOGY/ONCOLOGY 
 1-year TERM 
 CHEO/University of Ottawa
 The Department of Pediatrics at CHEO, University of Ottawa is recruiting a full-time locum Pediatric Oncologist within the Division of Hematology/Oncology to fill a 1-year term beginning in January 2027. This position may be renewable pending funding. 
 The ideal candidate will be Royal College (Pediatric Hematology/Oncology) certified or equivalent, who can provide inpatient and outpatient clinical services for infants and children with extra-cranial solid tumor and related cancer disorders . The candidate will be expected to provide weekend daytime coverage as needed.  While English is the language of the health record, functionality in French is an asset. 
 The Department of Pediatrics is affiliated with CHEO, the CHEO Research Institute and the University of Ottawa. Together, we provide outstanding patient care, leading research, and quality pediatric medical education. The Department of Pediatrics provides health care to newborns, children, and youth of the Ottawa area, as well as those from Eastern Ontario, Western Quebec, Nunavut and parts of Northern Ontario (population of approximately 1.8 million). The Department of Pediatrics has 18 distinct divisions, which includes Hematology/Oncology.
 The Division of Hematology/Oncology provides clinical care for general hematology/oncology as well as specialized clinics in leukemia, lymphoma, neuro-oncology, solid tumors, non-malignant hematology and post-stem cell and/or cellular therapy care.
 The successful candidate will provide comprehensive inpatient and outpatient care for children, adolescents and young adults with extra-cranial solid tumor malignancies (including sarcomas, neuroblastoma, renal tumors, liver tumors, germ cell tumors and/or other pediatric solid tumors) and will receive an academic appointment at the Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level within the Department of Pediatrics, Faculty of Medicine, University of Ottawa, commensurate with qualifications and experience . In this role, there will be opportunities to define the future direction of several strategic initiatives within the Division, including the expansion of regional and national leadership in solid tumor oncology, oncology fertility preservation and pediatric cancer genetics.
 CHEO has an active and accredited Pediatric Hematology/Oncology residency training program. The division is also involved in education for pediatric residents and medical students. We are active members of many research networks nationally and internationally and are also involved in education research.
 CHEO is a global leader in pediatric health care and research and the CHEO Research Institute is the fastest growing RI in Canada.
 The University of Ottawa is Canada's largest bilingual institution of higher learning and research. The Faculty of Medicine offers a wide range of competitive educational and research programs in a dynamic learning environment with state-of-the art facilities. The Faculty is recognized as a national leader in medical education and ranks among the top faculties of medicine worldwide for research intensity and impact.
 Ottawa is Canada's capital city, which blends the cultural diversity and vibrancy of a capital city with the warmth and atmosphere of a smaller community. We are committed to advancing equity, diversity, inclusion and indigeneity within our organization and the broader community.
 Candidates for this position must have an MD and be eligible for licensing in the Province of Ontario. All qualified candidates are invited to apply; however, preference will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents.  Priority will be given to candidates with certification with the Royal College of Physicians of Surgeons (Pediatric Hematology/Oncology). Equivalent training in other countries/jurisdictions will be considered.
 Qualified candidates are invited to submit an application until November 1, 2026.
 CHEO and the Department of Pediatrics are equal opportunity employers. We strongly encourage applications from individuals, including Indigenous peoples, those who identify as LGBTQ2S+, persons with disabilities and members of visible minorities. If you require an accommodation during any phase of the recruitment process, please contact the Department of Pediatric Associates at DPAHR@cheo.on.ca. All information received in relation to accommodation will be kept confidential and will be handled in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act.

Eyeball Grabber Wanted: You’ve written ads that interrupted the scroll. Emails that earned the click. Landing pages that made the offer feel obvious. Video scripts that hooked fast and held attention. And sales copy that turned complicated product benefits into simple, human, persuasive messages. You know how to write with empathy, clarity, proof, and punch. You can take a clinical study, a customer insight, a product USP, or a messy brief and turn it into copy that feels easy to read and hard to ignore.
 If that sounds like you, here’s your next big opportunity:
 We want a Copywriter to help us write high-performing, conversion-focused copy across ads, emails, sales pages, social, video scripts, blogs, and more.
 Small print here ⇒ We’re a women’s health supplement company. So if you can’t write in a way that makes women feel heard, understood, and safe enough to trust you… this isn’t the role for you. 
 Still here? Okay then…
 This job will give you ALL the feels:
 We create clinically supported, natural solutions for some of the biggest health challenges women over 40 face today. And your words will help more women discover those solutions.
 Your copy will help a menopausal woman understand her body better. Feel more confident in her choices. Take action. And maybe even change the way she thinks about her health, her future, and what’s possible for her.
 If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your copywriting career than here.
 This job might be for you if you’ve got…
 3–5 years of proven copywriting experience. When we look at your portfolio we’ll see a full-spectrum of ads, emails, landing pages, and sales pages that converted like a Kentucky Tent Revival. There’s no doubt about it… your copy SELLS!    
 Direct response chops that make your words cut through the clutter. You know how to write hooks, leads, headlines, subject lines, bullets, offers, calls-to-action, and sales arguments that pull people in and keep them reading. If you can make a reader think, “Okay, I need to know where this is going,” we want to talk.
 A Makepeace-like ability to turn product features into customer benefits. You don’t stop at “contains calcium, magnesium, boron, and vitamin D3.” You ask: Why does that matter? What does the customer already believe? What are they afraid of? What have they tried? What do they need to understand before this feels worth buying?
 A brain that can find the story in the science. You dig through a database of clinical studies, spot the strongest marketing nuggets, and turn them into a compelling product story. You don’t just summarize research. You connect the ingredients, doses, mechanisms, and results in a way that is clear, accurate, persuasive, and easy for a real human to understand. Bonus points if you’ve done this in health, wellness, supplements, or women’s health.
 A performance-driven approach to writing. You don’t treat copy like precious art carved into marble. You want to know what worked, what didn’t, and what to test next. CTR, CVR, CPA, open rate, click rate, rankings, traffic, revenue — these numbers don’t bruise your ego. They sharpen your instincts.
 A full-funnel writing brain. You understand that a Meta ad, an email, a sales page, a video script, an organic post, and a blog all have different jobs. You can shift tone, format, pace, and depth depending on the channel, while keeping the message consistent and on-brand.
 A strong understanding of hooks, angles, and offers. You know the difference between a headline that states a fact and a hook that creates momentum. You can find fresh angles in customer reviews, testimonials, research papers, competitor funnels, product details, and the quiet little objections most writers miss.
 The ability to write both short and long. You can write a 12-word ad hook, a 90-character description, a PWAT-style email, a 6,000-word sales page, or a VSL-style script without losing the thread. You know when to be punchy, when to explain, when to agitate, and when to get out of the reader’s way.
 A thick portfolio that shows you can sell. Show us copy that made people click, buy, book, watch, download, subscribe, or take the next step. And if you have results, bring them. We love results around here. We may even clap.
 A detective’s eye for customer insight. Reviews. Surveys. Testimonials. Comments. Competitor pages. Sales calls. Clinical studies. You know the best copy rarely starts with a blank page. It starts with listening.
 Experience writing SEO, AEO, or GEO content. You can write helpful, searchable content without sounding like you swallowed a keyword spreadsheet. You know how to answer real questions clearly, structure information well, and still make the copy feel warm, useful, and human.
 A healthy respect for compliance, claims, and accuracy. We work in the health space, which means “sounds convincing” is not good enough. Your copy needs to be truthful, sourced, compliant, and trustworthy. You know how to make a strong point without wandering into forbidden-claim territory wearing a blindfold.
 A detail-oriented editing brain. You catch typos, clunky transitions, unsupported claims, awkward phrasing, missing context, and sentences that sound like they were written by a robot with a vitamin deficiency.
 The ability to use AI without letting AI use you. You’re comfortable using AI tools for research, ideation, outlining, variation, and speed. But you still bring the strategy, taste, judgment, empathy, and final polish. 
 A collaborative, receptive attitude. You’ll work with marketers, designers, video editors, stakeholders, and other writers. You’ll get feedback. Sometimes a lot of it. You don’t need to defend every sentence like it’s a beloved family heirloom. You listen, revise, improve, and make the work better.
 The organization to handle multiple projects without going feral. Ads, emails, blogs, scripts, landing pages, revisions, research, feedback, deadlines — you can keep things moving, communicate early, and let people know when something is blocked.
 A genuine curiosity about the customer. You want to know what she’s worried about. What she’s tried. What she believes. What she secretly fears. What would make her feel relieved. What would make her trust us. That curiosity is what makes your copy feel like it was written for a person, not an avatar on someone’s Canva slide.
 Ecommerce experience would be lovely. Supplement experience would be even lovelier. Women’s health experience might make us swoon. But the real must-haves are strong direct response fundamentals, excellent research ability, clean writing, emotional intelligence, and a hunger to get better.
 Now, time to be honest: is this really you?
 If you’re nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we can’t wait to meet you.
 But if you think copywriting is mostly “story telling” or “making things sound nice,” this probably isn’t the role for you.
 We need someone who can write with heart and strategy.
 Someone who can make complex health information feel simple.
 Someone who can take feedback without crying like a baby.
 Someone who can care about the customer and the conversion.
 Someone who can write a subject line in the morning, research a clinical study before lunch, polish a landing page in the afternoon, and still have the brainpower to ask, “Is this actually the strongest angle?”
 If that sounds like you, you may have just found your people.
 Other Qualities You’ll Need
 At AlgaeCal, we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:
 You’re humble — you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own.
 You’re hungry — you want to learn more, improve your craft, and keep getting sharper.
 You’re people smart — in the sense that you’re a thoughtful, communicative, generous teammate.
 The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities, you won’t last long at AlgaeCal.
 So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.
 What Will You Earn?
 We believe in rewarding top talent.
 So let’s talk about salary once we’ve had the chance to get to know you better.
 Rest assured, we’re generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skill, curiosity, work ethic, and copywriting talent, we’ll make sure the compensation reflects that.
 You’ll also enjoy the following benefits:
 A generous healthcare package
 Monthly team events and activities
 Flexible Stat Holidays with the option to bank days for later use
 Weekly team lunches if you work from our Vancouver office
 Incredible dog-friendly Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
 Remote working is okay with us too
 And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave
 Culture is everything to us.
 Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible.
 But we know how to have fun, support each other, and reward ourselves too.
 How To Apply
 So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of Team AlgaeCal?
 Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicant.
 So, to make sure our future Copywriter is the real deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application.
 If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume, cover letter, and writing sample.

 Write a cover letter addressing:
 Why are you the best Copywriter for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements.
 Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1deCCJZ6tiDiOSlr_W0UdCuM_V_ahzPBs/view 
 What's the toughest challenge you’ve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?
 What are the last three books you’ve read?
 What do you do for fun?
 Explain what you’re doing now for a job:
 If you don’t have one, explain why.
 If you have one, explain why you’re looking elsewhere.
 Upload your cover letter and resume.
 Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.
 Must attach a piece of copy you’ve written.
 We want to see a sales page or landing page that you’ve written that clearly demonstrates your understanding of direct response marketing.  
 Please include the results it produced, if available. We love seeing real-world performance.
 Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best — and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.
 Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter, resume, and writing sample. 
 Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read! 
 We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly and you can expect a prompt response.

 The Scale: The team’s interfaces and standards influence how requirements are created and fulfilled across Risk, Onboarding, and product integrations—not just a single product experience. This requires broad cross-team influence across 6+ teams. It is currently 6 people and actively hiring.
 The Complexity: This role has technical complexity in both API design and system scalability / reliability. The underlying system is used broadly across all of Stripe, serves a high volume of traffic, and has critical SLOs backing meaningful user-facing APIs. The role also requires strong product judgment: translating risk-management needs into reusable APIs that work for Risk teams while delivering clear, effective remediation experiences for Stripe users.
 The Stakeholders: Partner with Risk Engineering teams, Onboarding, Product, Data Science, and product teams integrating with the platform. You will align decisioning, information-collection, and user-facing presentation experiences around consistent, explainable requirements.
 What you'll do
 As an Engineering Manager at Stripe, you will operate with full autonomy across a complex, high-impact area of our product or infrastructure. Your scope extends beyond a single team - you lead or strongly influence multiple engineering teams, execute on parallel high-priority workstreams, and develop senior engineering talent. You are expected to set direction, align stakeholders, make decisions that stick, and deliver results without needing to be directed.  Responsibilities
 Lead with Scope and Autonomy: Drive impact across multiple teams or a significant product area, fully independently.  Define Strategy and Roadmap: Develop the vision, strategy, and goals for your area without waiting to be told what to do. Anticipate user needs, technical challenges, and business priorities — and make decisions that hold up over time. Communicate your plan clearly and persuasively to both your team and senior leadership, and connect your team's work to Stripe's broader mission.
 Develop Senior Talent: Invest meaningfully in the growth of senior engineers and emerging leaders on your team. Provide direct coaching, create meaningful stretch opportunities, and give candid feedback that elevates both individual and collective performance. Managers, senior ICs, and high-potential engineers grow under your leadership.
 Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Build trusted, productive working relationships with stakeholders across Product, Design, and adjacent engineering teams. You resolve ambiguity at the intersections, align teams around shared priorities, and ensure your organization's work is understood and valued across Stripe.
 Hire and Scale the Team: Take a strategic and proactive approach to recruiting. You attract senior engineering talent, set a high hiring bar, and ensure every hire improves your team and Stripe as a whole. You have a demonstrated track record of building diverse, high-performing teams.
 Operate with Rigor: Instill a culture of high standards, ownership, and operational excellence across your organization. Proactively identify systemic issues, drive process improvements, and model the behaviors you want to see — including quality, urgency, and a sense of craft.

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience with 10+ years of software development experience
 4+ years of engineering management experience with a demonstrated, autonomous track record of impact as an EM — you deliver consistently without close direction
 Experience leading high-complexity engineering teams executing in parallel on multiple difficult, high-impact workstreams simultaneously
 Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority, communicating a clear direction that others follow
 Meaningful recruiting experience, including a track record of attracting and developing senior engineering talent
 Technical depth sufficient to guide architecture decisions and hold your team's work to a high standard across both product quality and engineering craft
 Preferred qualifications
 Experience managing a team which operates a critical service with demanding reliability and latency requirements.
 API design depth, with demonstrated ability to hold a high bar on API quality for a team whose primary product is an API.
