KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.
 We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.
 The mission of this role
 Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.
 Who are we?
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 What is our culture like & who is a good fit?
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
 Better Everyday – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round.
 Speed Is King – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day.
 Work Smart – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts.
 Overdeliver – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like)
 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.
 Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)
 Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)
 Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped
 AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)
 No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day
 Key Objectives
 Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first.
 Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells.
 Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners.
 Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor.
 Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix.
 Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house.
 Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting.
 Fully remote, full-time
 Fluent in English
 CRO Experience: 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must.
 Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV – with the data to back it up.
 Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages.
 Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help.
 Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency.
 Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule.
 Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin.
 No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work.
 Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
 Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
 Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience.
 Accountabilities
 What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.
 CRO test plan and backlog – Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next.
 Funnels – Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV.

 CRO agency – Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



As Senior Staff Product Manager, Device Security, you’ll define the strategy and roadmap for the device security capabilities that help organizations understand, control, and govern access across their environments. You’ll work at the intersection of device health, identity, access management, and Artificial Intelligence (AI), helping customers reduce security risk while building a more unified experience across people, machines, and AI agents.

You’ll partner with Engineering, Design, and Go To Market (GTM) teams to turn complex security challenges into products that are clear, useful, and measurable. Reporting to the Director, Product Management – Device Security, this is a remote role open to candidates in the United States or Canada.



How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

Required qualifications

• 8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of security, Identity and Access Management (IAM), endpoint, or access-control products.

• A track record of defining and delivering roadmaps for complex, cross-functional initiatives in a Business-to-Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.

• Experience contributing to product vision and strategy across multiple engineering teams or product areas.

• Strong written communication skills, with experience creating PRDs, PR/FAQs, and other artifacts that align teams and support decision-making.

• Experience defining Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), success metrics, and measurement frameworks connected to business outcomes.

• The ability to communicate complex security and product concepts clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior customer stakeholders.

• A customer-centered approach to prioritization that combines qualitative insight with quantitative data.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with endpoint security, device management, zero-trust, least-privilege architectures, or related security technologies.

• Familiarity with Mobile Device Management (MDM) or Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools.

• Experience working with enterprise administration consoles and IT buyer or administrator personas.

• Experience taking AI or machine-learning products from concept to initial launch.

• Experience prototyping with AI-enabled developer tools and curiosity about how AI agents operate.

• Familiarity with device compliance frameworks, endpoint telemetry platforms, or related security systems.



What you can expect:

Own and evolve the Device Security product roadmap, partnering with engineering leadership to define priorities and deliver key capabilities.

• Shape the role of Device Security within 1Password Unified Access and contribute to cross-company product strategy.

• Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly prioritization, balancing near-term delivery with an 18–24 month product vision.

• Represent the customer perspective through discovery, feedback loops, recorded and live demos, and structured product artifacts such as Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and Product Requirements/FAQs (PR/FAQs).

• Collaborate with Product Managers (PMs) across adjacent product areas, as well as Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Product Marketing.

• Establish success metrics that connect customer outcomes and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) contribution to product progress.

• Engage directly with enterprise customers, including Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs), Vice Presidents of Security, and Information Technology (IT) leaders.

• Prototype proof-of-value solutions using AI-enabled developer tools to explore and communicate product ideas.

Our culture

 Data Integration Design and Development  
 Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain data integrations that connect client data sources to the Prophix platform, applying integration best practices throughout. 
 Build real-time interfaces between cloud and on-premise systems, including RESTful APIs using JSON, to support secure and scalable data flows. 
 Connect Prophix's cloud environment (including AWS infrastructure) to the variety of source systems and data stores that customers bring, covering both cloud and on-premise applications. 
 Integration Strategy and Architecture

 Client Project Delivery and Stakeholder Support

 Collaboration and Mentorship

 Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying data integrations across disparate platforms and applications, spanning both cloud and on-premise systems. 
 Demonstrated experience building RESTful APIs using JSON for real-time system integration. 
 Experience interfacing data between cloud and on-premise applications and data stores. 
 Working knowledge of scripting or programming languages such as Javascript, Python, SQL, or SOQL. 
 Familiarity with Windows and/or SQL Server environments as a foundation for data system work. 
 Experience working with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure in the context of data connectivity or migration.
